request.prompt_seed: OpenTallas deterministic measured break-even service observation. Continue this neutral technical record without lists or tool calls. Record 0123456789 alpha beta gamma delta.

contamination_policy.label: shared_contended
contamination_policy.window_integrated_gpu_energy_semantics: contaminated whole-GPU observation only; never attribute it to the benchmark requests

measured_break_even.strict_speedup_semantics: 1.0x is median observed service equality; a superiority claim requires a statistically governed same-model measurement strictly above the comparator distribution under the same prompt, completion, context, concurrency, latency, software, and power scope

claim_boundary: The endpoint reports the Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct-FP8 root in text-only mode. The API does not expose a revision; accounting uses the sole local snapshot selected by the default main ref.
Other serving and audio processes share the GPU, so the observation is a service target rather than clean peak RTX PRO 6000 performance.
Whole-GPU energy is contaminated and may not be divided by benchmark tokens or requests.
Logical model bytes, operation lower bounds, and KV traffic are derived from pinned tensor headers and config; only service timing and token usage are measured.
The report derives what OpenTallas would need to equal the measured service; it does not show OpenTallas achieving those requirements.
